flash_629916.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat in North America, where they are being written now.

Updates will resume Saturday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat at 18:49 Jerusalem time.

Shabbat Shalom!

flash_695077.description:
Ofer Winter addresses the possibility of joining a Netanyahu-led government, makes clear he will not compromise on his demands: "I don't work for any individual."

(Arutz Sheva-Israel National News' North American desk is keeping you updated until the start of Shabbat in New York. The time posted automatically on all Israel National News articles, however, is Israeli time.)

flash_695078.description: IDF, Shin Bet, eliminates Islamic Jihad commander who infiltrated Israel on October 7, Hamas Nukhba terrorist in separate strikes in Khan Yunis.

flash_695096.description: Man, 28, seriously wounded in Yavne after gun allegedly discharged from legally owned firearm; police investigate.

flash_695095.description: Hatred has consequences, but sometimes, the young Jew they hoped to intimidate becomes the young Jew organising the next Shabbat dinner. Sometimes, the identity they hoped to weaken becomes the source of a person’s strength. Sometimes, our children lift a Torah above their heads and dance. Op-ed.

flash_695093.description: Searches underway near Lebanon border after foreign object identified mid-air

flash_695091.description: Our ability to stand against the attacks of terror, falsehood, and wickedness of our Muslim enemies and those who do their bidding lies in the fundamental and basic understanding of the first Rashi of Breishit that “He declared the power of His deeds to His people."

flash_695089.description: Joint List chairman Yousef Jabareen says party prepared to support any government that replaces Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, but demands progress toward Palestinian state.

flash_695087.description: The British boycott Israeli products for false claims of "settler violence, but their policies include the turning of a blind eye to PA glorification of real, proven Arab terrorism. Opinion.

flash_695085.description: Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz rejects calls to withdraw from elections, dismissing claims of wasted votes.

flash_695083.description: Israeli airstrikes eliminate several Hamas Nukhba terrorists gathered in Gaza City, senior Islamic Jihad anti-tank commander in northern Gaza, amid continued ceasefire violations.

flash_695081.description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog invites Captain Smit Machchhar to Jerusalem, pledges to honor him with presidential award once he recovers.

flash_695079.description:
IDF: A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a suspicious aerial target identified in the area in which IDF soldiers are operating in southern Lebanon. The interception results are under review.

No sirens were sounded in accordance with protocol.

flash_695103.description: At least 12 people killed and 309 wounded in a missile attack on Riyadh's airport, believed to have been carried out by the Houthis.

flash_695102.description: Trump administration urged Israel to launch a strike against Iran amid concerns over Tehran's military buildup, asking Israel to bear political risks ahead of elections, journalist Ben Caspit reports.

flash_695100.description: Unconfirmed report: Houthi strike on Saudi airport left 12 dead, 50 injured

flash_695098.description:
IDF: Following the sirens sounded at 19:57 in Arab al-Aramshe, IDF surveillance identified an unknown aerial subject on the border with Lebanon.

IDF soldiers are continuing to search the area, and until now, no suspicious findings were located. There are currently no special instructions for the home front.

flash_695097.description: Moving video contrasts Simchat Torah at Sderot Yeshiva just hours after the October 7 massacre, with students singing under armed guard, and this year's celebrations filled with dancing and joy. Watch.

flash_695092.description: Israel providing drinking water, essential food supplies, to communities affected by Panama earthquake, following instructions from Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar.

flash_695090.description: The humanity of animals and the barbarity of man. Opinion.

flash_695086.description: A powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake struck Panama on Friday, October 9, causing widespread damage to buildings and infrastructure, injuring at least 27 people and prompting evacuations across the country.

flash_695084.description: Israel has revealed the name of the IDF's emergency protocol for a civilian aircraft hijacking, used during the Flydubai incident.

flash_695080.description: Israeli Air Force delegation participates in Marrakech Airshow for the first time since the Abraham Accords, meeting Moroccan military officials to strengthen defense ties and cooperation.

flash_695120.description: Ditza Or says a Hamas captor told her son the group was too weak to hold the remaining hostages, arguing that military pressure forced their release.

flash_695119.description: IDF radar systems detected an unidentified object in the skies near the Israel-Lebanon border last night. IDF forces are conducting ground and aerial searches in an attempt to determine what it was.

flash_695118.description: Nearly all Haredi and religious respondents attribute the rescue of passengers on the flight from Dubai to “Divine Providence," as do most traditional Jews.

flash_695116.description: Knowing the Torah’s guidance for living obligates men and women equally. Encompassing the entire Torah, commandments that are relevant to the learner’s life and those that are not, and continued study of the Torah in depth, obligates only men.

flash_695114.description: Likud has established a team of MKs and strategic advisers to examine candidates from Gadi Eisenkot's party, aiming to persuade lawmakers to join the right-wing bloc after the elections.

flash_695112.description:
In a conversation with reporters, US President Donald Trump referred to the Houthi attack on Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia, and condemned it, saying: "I think it's terrible."

When asked whether the United States military would intervene following the attack, Trump replied curtly: "You'll find out."

flash_695110.description: Columbia University apologizes after a dining menu lists "October 7th Blush Sauce" on the Hamas massacre anniversary, calling the wording an accidental error.

flash_695108.description: CENTCOM says a US fighter jet disabled a Panama-flagged cargo ship in the Gulf of Oman after it ignored warnings and attempted to breach the naval blockade against Iran.

flash_695106.description: President Trump honors 18 US servicemembers killed in the Iran war, saying their sacrifice helped prevent Tehran from obtaining nuclear weapons.

flash_695104.description: Former Sephardic Chief Rabbi Yitzhak Yosef criticizes the public attacks on yeshiva students and the use of the terms "draft evaders" during his weekly lecture in Jerusalem.

flash_695101.description: Yaakov Farag was murdered while guarding Har Bracha in 1988. Now, his widow is demanding that the IDF demolish a nearby monument commemorating his killer.

flash_695099.description: The Jews are well and soundly surrounded by genocidal hatred, based on false Blood Libels, and Navi Pillay has helped to spread them. Opinion.

flash_695094.description: Iris Haim, whose son Yotam was mistakenly killed by IDF fire in Gaza, accuses former hostage commander Nitzan Alon of ignoring warnings, distress calls and signs that could have led to his rescue.

flash_695140.description: 25 bereaved family members and fellow runners take part in the Chicago Marathon, running in memory of loved ones. The team left Israel on October 7, three years after the massacre, following months of joint training.

flash_695139.description: Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich warns that a change of government could threaten yeshivas, religious institutions and Jewish communities in Judea and Samaria.

flash_695138.description: Digging tools found in a cave near Rosh HaAyin. The IDF ruled out a tunnel but circumstances surrounding the excavation are still under investigation.

flash_695136.description: Israel allowed Qatar to funnel more than $100 million in aid to Gaza during the war and hostage negotiations, including fuel, food and infrastructure repairs, raising concerns that Hamas benefited indirectly.

flash_695134.description: Border Police arrested two Palestinian Arabs in al-Ram over an August rock attack in Binyamin that left a female officer injured.

flash_695132.description: A Haaretz editorial attacks Ben Gvir's policies toward terrorist prisoners: "Security prisons have become torture facilities."

flash_695130.description: IAI's new POINT@AIR system combines long-range radar detection, 360-degree coverage, and continuous surveillance using a compact, mobile aerostat platform.

flash_695128.description:
Police officers from the Judea and Samaria District and Border Police forces arrested a Palestinian Arab man in his 20s, a resident of Al-Eizariya, following a report that he had expressed an intention to carry out a terrorist attack imminently.

The suspect, who was masked, was located and arrested in the village of Al-Eizariya while carrying a knife and a glass cup containing nails and paper, which are suspected of having been intended for throwing and setting on fire.

The suspect was transferred for questioning at the Ma'ale Adumim police station and taken into custody.

The investigation is ongoing and is being conducted by the counterterrorism unit of the Judea and Samaria District Central Investigations Unit.

flash_695127.description: Zehut Party Chairman Moshe Feiglin responds to Tucker Carlson's criticism of his remarks on Gaza, accusing him of hypocrisy and calling for Gaza to return to Jewish control

flash_695126.description: German journalist Serena Bilanceri called for economic and military sanctions against Israel. The Population and Immigration Authority accepted a recommendation to bar her entry into the country.

flash_695124.description: Iron Police Station officers raided businesses and seized dozens of kilograms of suspected counterfeit hookah tobacco, along with beverage cans suspected of having been smuggled into Israel.

flash_695122.description: 300-meter section of ancient aqueduct dating to the Hasmonean period discovered during excavations ahead of construction of new Jerusalem neighborhood. Historic structure to be preserved and displayed to the public.

flash_695117.description: Former Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit is set to testify for Netanyahu’s defense, with questioning expected to focus on investigative approvals and alleged pressure.

flash_695115.description: Yonit Levi responds to NYC Mayor's Oct. 7 statements, arguing against comparing the massacre to Israel's war, and saying that doing so on that day in particular is 'inexcusable.'

flash_695113.description: What is happening in France concerns the entire West. These are extremely serious social-racial uprisings aimed at the destruction of our countries and our culture. Opinion.

flash_695111.description: Lebanese security forces reportedly arrest two suspected Hezbollah members carrying 500 kilograms of explosives, including TNT and C4, in a car bound for Beirut.

flash_695158.description: Baghdad goes through the motions of pushing disarmament deadlines into the distant future, but Iranian officials have made it clear that their proxies are in Iraq to stay. Things can be done to make that a untenable for Iraq. Opinion.

flash_695156.description:
A poll conducted by the Kantar Institute and published by Kan News found that if elections were held today, Yashar would win 22 seats, the Likud 20, Beyachad (Together) 12, and Otzma Yehudit 9.

Read More

flash_695157.description: Two security officials were arrested in a dramatic early-morning operation and barred from meeting their lawyers as a court extends their detention.

flash_695154.description: A two-year-old girl who was critically injured after being struck by a car in Bu'eine Nujeidat has died at Poriya Medical Center.

flash_695152.description:
A 42-year-old man and a four-year-old boy were moderately injured, and eight others sustained minor injuries in an accident on Route 444 at Givat Koah Junction.

MDA teams treated the injured and evacuated them to Beilinson Hospital in Petah Tikva and Sheba Medical Center at Tel Hashomer.

flash_695150.description: The Petah Tikva Magistrate’s Court has extended by four days the detention of two security personnel from Samaria suspected of involvement in a violent incident near Aqraba.

flash_695148.description: The main defendant in the murder of 15-year-old Yamanu Zalka admitted stabbing him in the leg, but argued he did not foresee the fatal outcome.

flash_695146.description: A candidate named Hitler Mussolini Simeón Flores has won a mayoral election in Peru by just 25 votes. He is not the first person with a name associated with Nazi Germany to win elected office in recent years.

flash_695144.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu condemned the Houthi attack on Riyadh airport, saying: “Terror targets innocent people and seeks to spread fear. It must be confronted with determination."

Netanyahu added: “Israel looks forward to a strong Middle East - one that stands united against threats, protects its people, and builds a future of security, cooperation, and prosperity for all the peoples of our region."

flash_695143.description: US President Donald Trump announced that Russia and Ukraine would stop attacking each other’s energy facilities, warning both sides: “Do not violate the agreement."

flash_695141.description: Israel’s Privacy Protection Authority has ordered a police inquiry after private messages, AI searches and financial information about Mali and Liel Yahalomi were leaked.

flash_695137.description: 'A rock doesn’t become dangerous only when it hits Tel Aviv,' Binyamin Council chief Israel Ganz slams media, after rocks hurled at cars speeding along the Ayalon Highway damaged several vehicles.

flash_695135.description: Israel Police arrested a Haifa resident suspected of stealing holy books from the tomb of the Talmudic sage Rabbi Avdimi of Haifa, setting them on fire, and documenting the act.

flash_695133.description: Brig. Gen. Yogev Bar-Sheshet will leave the IDF after a command review into alleged abuse of authority and disclosure of classified information.

flash_695131.description: Man dies after entering a tiger enclosure at Yorkshire Wildlife Park in England.

flash_695129.description: How can Israel prepare for an October 7-style attack originating in Judea and Samaria? Col. (res.) Hezi Nehama answers.

flash_695167.description: Otzma Yehudit chairman Itamar Ben Gvir warns that Likud could join forces with Gadi Eisenkot, but stresses: "My only candidate for prime minister is Netanyahu."

flash_695166.description:
A military exercise will take place Monday morning in the Dead Sea hotel area, within the Tamar and Megilot Regional Councils.

During the exercise, increased activity by security forces and military vehicles is expected in the area, and gunfire and explosions will be heard.

flash_695164.description:
IDF forces operating in the southern Gaza Strip identified a terrorist earlier on Sunday who crossed the Yellow Line and, according to the military, posed an immediate threat.

The forces eliminated the terrorist shortly after identifying him.

flash_695163.description: Together chairman Naftali Bennett says Netanyahu could serve as a minister in his government if he accepts his party's principles. Eisenkot and Liberman reject the idea.

flash_695161.description: For “self-sacrificing" terrorist enemies, nothing could be more fulfilling than the publicity and eternal fame conferred by a US firing squad. Opinion.

flash_695159.description: Rabbi David Ben Pinchas, who lost his daughter in a car accident and his son in battle in Rafah, speaks about grief, his son’s heroism and faith that remains unshaken: “The pain remains, but it does not affect my faith."

flash_695155.description: Netanyahu calls on IDF Chief of Staff, Shin Bet chief, and Attorney General to launch investigation on participants in the film “Naza."

flash_695153.description:
An interceptor was launched a short time ago at a suspicious aerial target identified in an area of southern Lebanon where IDF forces are operating. The results of the interception are being investigated.

No alerts were activated, in accordance with policy.

flash_695151.description: Knesset Speaker Amir Ohana appealed to President Isaac Herzog on Sunday, urging him to grant Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a pardon following former Attorney General Avichai Mandelblit’s testimony in Netanyahu’s trial.

flash_695147.description: The IDF released footage and intelligence indicating that Hamas is continuing to keep the Kamal Adwan Hospital in Jabaliya fully operational.

flash_695145.description: With daily flights between New York and Israel except Shabbat, expanded aircraft capacity, kosher meals, and a new JetBlue agreement, Arkia is offering travelers greater flexibility and connectivity.

flash_695142.description: The IDF eliminated a Hamas Nukhba commander who helped lead the October 7 massacre on the Kissufim outpost and participated in abducting Israelis.

flash_695175.description: Prime Minister Netanyahu calls on the IDF Chief of Staff, Shin Bet chief, and Attorney General to launch a comprehensive investigation into participants in the anti-Israel film and pursue criminal charges.

flash_695174.description:
The Saudi-led military coalition announced that it intercepted a missile launched by the Houthi terrorist organization toward the city of Khamis Mushait in southwestern Saudi Arabia.

Shortly before the interception was announced, incoming missile alerts were activated in the nearby city of Abha.

flash_695172.description: The FAA warns US airlines of aviation risks over Saudi Arabia following deadly strikes on Riyadh airport, citing military activity and navigation interference.

flash_695170.description:
The British Embassy in Saudi Arabia issued a travel advisory urging British nationals to avoid nonessential travel to the cities of Jeddah and Dammam, as well as to all airports across the country, with the exception of the airport in Medina.

Meanwhile, the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) instructed American airlines to exercise heightened caution when operating flights to Saudi Arabia.

flash_695169.description: Iran says the US response to its seven conditions for reopening the Strait of Hormuz is insufficient, as indirect negotiations continue through Qatar.

flash_695168.description:
Saudi Arabia's General Authority of Civil Aviation announced that a Pakistani national was killed and 11 others were injured in an attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh on Sunday afternoon.

The injured were evacuated for medical treatment. According to the authority, the attack also caused property damage.

flash_695165.description: Footage published by Al Arabiya shows the Houthi missile attack on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport that killed at least 13 people and injured over 300.

flash_695162.description: Shas chairman Yinon Azoulay says Jewish schools should employ Jewish teachers exclusively.

flash_695160.description: Israel has approved an American team's entry into Gaza to map sites where Hamas terrorists could surrender their weapons.

flash_695149.description: Polish foreign minister: Man arrested for plotting attack against prime minister

flash_695202.description: Itamar residents protest IDF's decision to allow Arab olive harvesting near community's security fence, close to route used by terrorists who murdered five members of the Fogel family in 2011.

flash_695201.description: Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara approved questioning MK Yitzhak Kroizer under caution over a clash with police, while Kroizer says officers assaulted him.

flash_695199.description: Muslim Brotherhood-linked media outlets are reportedly facing unpaid salaries, layoffs and possible closures as funding declines and operating losses mount.

flash_695197.description: The Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation has extended the suspension of operational activities at King Khalid Airport in Riyadh after a Houthi missile strike killed one, a day after a strike killed 13.

flash_695195.description: From Agnon’s Forest to the Streets of Europe.

flash_695193.description: The Supreme Court ordered the IDF to present a timetable for residents’ return to Jenin, Tulkarm, and Nur Shams camps despite stated security concerns.

flash_695191.description: It’s impossible to be anti-Israel enough for an anti-Semitic movement. Opinion.

flash_695189.description: Herzog tells French Jewish leaders that Europe is scapegoating Jews and warns that boycotts and sanctions against Israel harm Arabs while shielding Hamas from responsibility.

flash_695187.description: The IDF plans to reduce its permanent presence in Gaza envelope communities after the elections, with reservists remaining only in towns closest to the border.

flash_695185.description: A police drone spotted a motorcyclist riding recklessly through Nazareth, tracked him from the air, and guided officers on the ground to make the arrest.

flash_695183.description: As Albert Einstein famously said: “Coincidence is Gd’s way of remaining anonymous."

flash_695181.description: Police arrest 17 suspects, detain seven others, in major corruption investigation involving a central Israeli municipality.

flash_695179.description: Colombia will open an embassy in Jerusalem on Wednesday, becoming the 10th country to do so as President Abelardo de la Espriella strengthens ties with Israel.

flash_695177.description: The District Court rejects Sara Netanyahu's request to dismiss a defamation lawsuit filed against her by Yair Golan and orders her to pay 2,000 shekels in legal expenses.

flash_695173.description: Amazon is reportedly negotiating a $7 billion acquisition of Israeli AI startup Decart, founded in 2023 and known for its real-time video editing technology.

flash_695247.description: In a statement to Arutz Sheva, Professor Anne Bayefsky accuses the Nobel Committee of rewarding anti-Israel hostility and warns that the decision sends a dangerous message to international lawyers.

flash_695246.description: Amid record defense exports exceeding $19.2 billion, Israel's Defense Ministry brings 19 companies to AUSA 2026 in Washington, showcasing advanced drone interception, electronic warfare, and AI-powered surveillance technologies.

flash_695245.description: An Ethiopian Airlines cargo flight to Tel Aviv returned to Ethiopia after one of its pilots was identified as an Indonesian citizen. The pilot was replaced, and the flight resumed.

flash_695243.description: President Isaac Herzog honors Israel Bonds for raising more than $58 billion over 75 years, including $8.5 billion since October 7.

flash_695241.description: According to initial reports, explosions were heard in Riyadh, the capital of Saudi Arabia.

flash_695239.description: Eitan Masaori, a student injured by shrapnel in his neck, told the PM that another student had been playing with the munition before the explosion.

flash_695237.description: Three foreign activists, including the president of an anti-Israel organization that promotes BDS, who filmed IDF soldiers in Hebron will be deported from Israel after photos of soldiers from previous shifts were found.

flash_695235.description: Security camera footage captured the moment an electric bicycle rider collided with a car in Bnei Brak.

flash_695233.description:
Britain announced the imposition of sanctions against two elements of the Iranian regime for their involvement in espionage activities for Iran.

One of them is a senior member of the Revolutionary Guards, and the other is linked to a network that works to harm opponents of the Iranian regime.

flash_695232.description: Katz warns the High Court against intervening in IDF’s activities in northern Samaria refugee camps, vows to maintain IDF presence, even if special legislation is needed.

flash_695231.description:
The United States, Australia, Canada and other countries issued a joint statement against Iranian activity on their territory.

The statement said that "any attempt by Iran to threaten, silence, intimidate, harass or harm people on our territory, through proxies or by any other means, is unacceptable."

flash_695229.description: Ahead of the Oct 7 anniversary, Britain’s Green party shockers hitched their wagon to The Holocaust creed: Jews have forfeited the right to exist. Modern antisemitic movements have mastered the playbook (for manipulating human nature. Opinion.

flash_695227.description: The sweetness of Torah becomes meaningful because human beings can choose something else. Opinion.

flash_695225.description:
The Health Ministry announced that, following the unexploded ordnance blast on Ramim Ridge, Ziv Medical Center in Tzfat has opened a center to treat people suffering from acute trauma, including a dedicated mental health team for children and teenagers.

Meanwhile, resilience centers in the Eastern and Western Galilee are working with local authorities and the Education Ministry to provide psychological support to students, families, and residents of the area.

flash_695224.description:
Rambam Medical Center in Haifa released footage showing the arrival of four people injured in an unexploded ordnance blast during a hike on Ramim Ridge in the Upper Galilee.

The injured, three teenagers and one adult, were evacuated to the hospital by two helicopters. Their condition is classified as moderate.

תיעוד: רגעי קליטת הפצועים מאסון הטיול ברכס רמים ברמב"ם

flash_695223.description: The difference between Noach and Avraham Avinu sheds important light on this question.

flash_695222.description:
Israel Police Commissioner Danny Levy said that, in coordination with the IDF, organized trips will be scaled back in the coming days to reassess potential dangers in the area following the deadly unexploded ordnance blast on Ramim Ridge.

“In the coming days, we will reduce the number of trips to reexamine whether we are putting children at risk by allowing them to go out," Levy said.

flash_695221.description:
Israel Police Commissioner Danny Levy addressed the permits issued for the trip, saying: “There is an established procedure for trips, including in this area. To the best of my understanding, this trip received approval from the relevant authorities."

Read More

flash_695220.description: An initial investigation reveals the sequence of events leading to the tragedy in which 1 was killed and 19 wounded.

flash_695219.description:
Israel Police Commissioner Danny Levy and Northern District Commander Meir Eliyahu are conducting a situation assessment at the scene of the unexploded ordnance blast on Ramim Ridge, together with security and rescue forces.

The two are being briefed on the details and circumstances of the incident.

Read More

flash_695218.description:
The IDF is investigating the possibility that the deadly explosion during a trip by students from ORT Ma’alot religious high school on Ramim Ridge was caused by a piece of munitions left behind after military activity.

According to the theory being examined, one of the students picked up an unexploded ordnance and put it in his bag. It later exploded, causing the tragedy.

Read More
